questions.questionHtml:
By interchanging the given two signs and numbers which of the following equation will be correct?

+ and ×, 1 and 2
questions.solution:
According to the question, after interchanging the given two signs and numbers :

  1. + and ×
  2. 1 and 2

So,

  • Option - (1) : 8 × 3 – 4 ÷ 2 + 1 = 7

​​After interchanging:

8 + 3 – 4 ÷ 1 × 2 = 7

8 + 3 – 4 × 2 = 7

8 + 3 - 8 = 7

11 - 8 = 7

3 ≠ 7 (LHS ≠ RHS)

  • Option - (2) : 2 × 3 – 8 ÷ 1 + 9 = 18

​After interchanging:

1 + 3 – 8 ÷ 2 × 9 = 18

1 + 3 - 4 × 9 = 18

1 + 3 - 36 = 18

4 - 36 = 18

-32 ≠ 18 (LHS ≠ RHS)

  • Option - (3) : 8 × 3 – 4 ÷ 2 + 1 = 3

​​After interchanging:

8 + 3 – 4 ÷ 1 × 2 = 3

8 + 3 – 4 × 2 = 3

8 + 3 - 8 = 3

11 - 8 = 3

3 = 3 (LHS = RHS)

  • Option - (4) : 2 × 3 – 8 ÷ 1 + 2 = 5

​​After interchanging:

1 + 3 – 8 ÷ 2 × 1 = 5

1 + 3 - 4 × 1 = 5

1 + 3 - 4 = 5

4 - 4 = 5

0  ≠ 5 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Here, digit - (2) is repeated, therefore this option is invalid.

Hence, "Option - (3)" is the correct answer.

  • (6, 22, 14)

14 - 3 = 11

11 = 11 (LHS = RHS)

  • (8, 30, 19)​

​19 - 8 ÷ 2  = 30 ÷ 2

19 - 4 = 15

15 = 15 (LHS = RHS)

​So,

  • Option - (1) : (12, 46, 27)​

21 ≠ 23 (LHS ≠ RHS)

  • Option - (2) : (4, 18, 11)​

11 - 2 = 9

9 = 9 (LHS = RHS)

  • Option - (4) : (9, 34, 22)​

questions.solution: Aschelminthes, also known as roundworms, have a circular cross-section and can be free-living or parasitic in plants and animals. They are distinguished by having a pseudocoelom and are found in freshwater and soil. As endoparasites, Ascaris is discovered to exist in human intestines. Their bodies are triploblastic, bilaterally symmetric, long, slender, and not segmented. They lack metameric segmentation and males are often smaller than females. Aschelminthes have an organ-system level organization.

questions.questionHtml:
The question below consists of a set of labeled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph.

P. The award is named after Alfred Nobel, the Swedish inventor of dynamite.

Q. A Nobel Prize is an award that is given to someone whose work has benefitted society.

R. This award is given in six categories, and medicine is one of those categories.

S. This year Professors David Julius and Ardem Petapoutian have won this prize for medicine.
questions.solution: The correct answer is: QPRS. The paragraph begins by defining the Nobel Prize (Q), which introduces the subject. It then provides historical context regarding its name (P). Sentence (R) explains the structure of the award by mentioning the categories, specifically medicine. Finally, (S) concludes with a specific example of recent winners in that category, providing a logical flow from general definition to specific instance.
